subject: Ignite trial setup — next steps & kickoff resources

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & mutual action plan (Ignite trial)

Sam — great talking earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment and can get your trial running this week: 

Summary of what we covered
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for low-latency customer-facing recommendations at Ignite (10k qps target in production).
- Trial target: POC cluster with 2 GPU nodes, example dataset for recommendation reranking, run 3k inference/day for 2 weeks.
- Success metrics: tail latency <120ms 95th, P95 cost under $0.015/token equivalent, model quality parity vs current baseline on holdout test.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan attached)
1) Assign a technical owner on Ignite side (platform/infra) — we need someone who can share IAM details or allow access to a sandbox.
2) We provide a short concierge setup (30–60m) to provision the trial environment and upload the sample data.
3) Kickoff date: pick a window next week (Mon/Tue) and we’ll reserve a dedicated engineer.

Attachments: Ignite_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan) and a trial checklist PDF. I also dropped a short one-page setup guide at https://redwood.app/s/ignite/MAP.

If priorities shifted, let me know — we can compress the plan down to a single quick test run if you prefer. Otherwise, can you confirm who on your side will be the technical owner and whether Mon 6/7 or Tue 6/8 works for a 30–45m concierge session?

Thanks,
Rishi
